repos_data.description: ⌘⌘ - A lightweight, native macOS screenshot tool that lives in your menu bar. Double-tap ⌘ Command to capture any region of your screen — instantly copied to clipboard, or annotate first with pen and mosaic tools.
easy to use mac osx image editing application for the rest of us

MS Paint for the Mac. Native, free and open source: blank canvas at any size, drop one image onto another, crop, and mark up screenshots. Ships PaintKit, a UI-free drawing engine with no AppKit and no third-party dependencies: macOS 12+, and swift test runs it in a fresh clone with no Xcode.
MCP server for Nanana AI image generation powered by Google Gemini's nano banana
